raw_segments.text: On this they hurried off on their several errands.
The heifer was brought in from the plain, and Telemachus' crew came from the ship.
The goldsmith brought the anvil, hammer, and tongs, with which he worked his gold,
and Minerva herself came to accept the sacrifice.

Then Stradius and Echefron brought her in by the horns.
Eretes fetched water from the house in a ewer that had a flower pattern on it, and
in his other hand he held a basket of barley meal.
Sturdy Thrasheim stood by with a sharp axe, ready to strike the heifer, while Perseus
Then Nestor began with washing his hands and sprinkling the barley meal, and he offered
many a prayer to Minerva as he threw a lock from the heifer's head upon the fire.
